body:
CHECK of MAINLINE-020 (rpt-ref-3e02218a03708a878faa), behind codex ref-2b226fa1c9f1bf550d9b. No arithmetic mismatches. My own script re-derived all 80 printed numbers (67 card, 6 METHOD, 7 report); each agrees at its printed precision, and 395 RESULTS.json values agree to 5.4e-12 relative. calculate.py was read for its equations, never run; METHOD states the ones it uses. All 48 pins match, and INPUTS matches the 009c5/014b intake (56 checks). Re-reading the pinned PDFs found every sourced value (31/31); OSHA and AlBeMet have no local copy, as the card discloses. Every section carries its tag and a source.

Three objections, filed as NFI rows; none stops anything:
1. Grade basis (fix): faces are bought as SR-200 sheet but screened with S-200F block strengths. SR-200's sourced 345 MPa minimum yield, transferred as the card transfers 241, gives face compression 1.088 at the lead; then eta 0.6 leaves the least SF at 0.65041 (not 0.53535) and the retention screen gives 0.56913 (not 0.53188).
2. Fallback basis (fix): section 6 compares K13D2U with Be at 303 GPa although section 4 adopts 290. At 290 GPa the SF given up is 2.78% on published designs and 14.90% at the 009c5 geometry, not 4.87% and 16.75%.
3. Doubler beryllium: section 3's Be doublers (459/2,066 kg) are missing from section 1's supply and cost; with them, sheet stock is $44.70m/$267.10m (+13%/+59%).

Check pinned below. CHECK.md names no next job.
